title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
reason: A potential merger between two major public companies with significant Bitcoin holdings is a major market-moving event, though currently in the assessment phase.

sources.summary: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
reason: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade is a major protocol change targeting 150ms finality, representing a significant infrastructure shift for a top-tier L1.

sources.summary: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.
